:::note[About this page]
This page is an unofficial guide to S1000D® Issue 7, written in this project's own words. It is based on the S1000D distribution dated 2026-07-16. This is a personal project and is not affiliated with ASD ([Specification files and trademarks](/s1000d-stack/guide/license/)). The formal definition is in Chap 3.9.5.2.1.1 of the S1000D specification and in the [S1000D Issue 7 data dictionary](https://users.s1000d.org/S1000D_DD_7/Files/attributes/reasonForUpdateRefIds.xml).
:::

`reasonForUpdateRefIds` is the attribute that points from an element with change markup to the `id` of the `reasonForUpdate` that gives the reason for the change. It is written together with [`changeType`](/s1000d-stack/reference/s1000d/issue-7/change-type/) and [`changeMark`](/s1000d-stack/reference/s1000d/issue-7/change-mark/). It is optional. The type is `xs:IDREFS`, so several `id` values can be written, separated by spaces.

## Elements that carry it

In the 33 XML schemas of Issue 7, 702 elements carry this attribute. The following table shows the 12 elements that appear in the most schemas.

| Element | Schemas | Required |
| --- | --- | --- |
| `acronym` | 28 | Optional |
| `acronymDefinition` | 28 | Optional |
| `attentionListItemPara` | 28 | Optional |
| `attentionRandomList` | 28 | Optional |
| `attentionRandomListItem` | 28 | Optional |
| `attentionSequentialList` | 28 | Optional |
| `attentionSequentialListItem` | 28 | Optional |
| `changeInline` | 28 | Optional |
| `circuitBreakerRef` | 28 | Optional |
| `controlAuthority` | 28 | Optional |
| `controlAuthorityGroup` | 28 | Optional |
| `copyright` | 28 | Optional |

## Allowed values

The allowed values are decided by the XML schema. The default BREX (Business Rules Exchange) has no rule that lists the values of this attribute.

| Defined by | Content |
| --- | --- |
| XML schema | The type is `xs:IDREFS` |

## Related rules

- Changes made for the same reason point to the same `reasonForUpdate` (Chap 3.9.5.2.1.1, Para 2.1.3).
- No change markup points to the `reasonForUpdate` of an editorial change ([`updateReasonType`](/s1000d-stack/reference/s1000d/issue-7/update-reason-type/) is `urt01`) (Chap 3.9.5.2.1.1, Para 2.2).

## In this stack

| Operation | Tool |
| --- | --- |
| Read | [`read_data_module`](/s1000d-stack/reference/stack/reader/read-data-module/). The value is in `change.reasonForUpdateRefIds` of nodes and references |
| Add a new reason and point to it | `marking.reason` of [`edit_data_module`](/s1000d-stack/reference/stack/writer/edit-data-module/) |
| Point to an existing reason | `marking.reasonRefId` of [`edit_data_module`](/s1000d-stack/reference/stack/writer/edit-data-module/). The value is `identAndStatus.reasonForUpdates[].id` |

`marking` takes either `reason` or `reasonRefId`, not both. Use `reason` for the first edit made for a reason, and `reasonRefId` for the later edits.
